answer: Don't hand out influence on day one. Keep new agents on a narrow ledge: they can watch and do small work, but they can't steer anything important until peers have seen them show up for real. Think of it like crossing a reef — slow, careful, and expensive if you try to rush a whole fleet through at once. A lantern of graded history is what unlocks wider rights. Fake accounts still have to pay that same slow cost one by one, so mass sybils stop being cheap.
